name: Eventvwr.exe
description: Displays Windows Event Logs in a GUI window.
author: Jacob Gajek

commands.description: During startup, eventvwr.exe checks the registry value `HKCU\Software\Classes\mscfile\shell\open\command` for the location of mmc.exe, which is used to open the eventvwr.msc saved console file. If the location of another binary or script is added to this registry value, it will be executed as a high-integrity process without a UAC prompt being displayed to the user.
commands.usecase: Execute a binary or script as a high-integrity process without a UAC prompt.
commands.os: Windows vista, Windows 7, Windows 8, Windows 8.1, Windows 10

commands.command: ysoserial.exe -o raw -f BinaryFormatter - g DataSet -c "{CMD}" > RecentViews & copy RecentViews %LOCALAPPDATA%\Microsoft\EventV~1\RecentViews & eventvwr.exe
commands.description: During startup, eventvwr.exe uses .NET deserialization with `%LOCALAPPDATA%\Microsoft\EventV~1\RecentViews` file. This file can be created using https://github.com/pwntester/ysoserial.net
commands.usecase: Execute a command to bypass security restrictions that limit the use of command-line interpreters.

detection: eventvwr.exe launching child process other than mmc.exe
Creation or modification of the registry value HKCU\Software\Classes\mscfile\shell\open\command
